title: Cross Product — Component Form and Area of Parallelogram
notes: **Component-form formula**: for $\vec{A}=A_1\hat{i}+A_2\hat{j}+A_3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{B}=B_1\hat{i}+B_2\hat{j}+B_3\hat{k}$, the cross product is the determinant $\vec{A}\times\vec{B}=\begin{vmatrix}\hat{i}&\hat{j}&\hat{k}\\A_1&A_2&A_3\\B_1&B_2&B_3\end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(A_2B_3-A_3B_2) - \hat{j}(A_1B_3-A_3B_1) + \hat{k}(A_1B_2-A_2B_1)$.
**Area of a parallelogram** whose adjacent sides are represented by $\vec{A}$ and $\vec{B}$ is Area $=|\vec{A}\times\vec{B}|$.

**Worked example**: find the cross product and the area of the parallelogram whose adjacent sides are $\vec{A}=\hat{i}+2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $\vec{B}=2\hat{i}-3\hat{j}+4\hat{k}$. $\vec{A}\times\vec{B} = \hat{i}(2\cdot4-3\cdot(-3)) - \hat{j}(1\cdot4-3\cdot2) + \hat{k}(1\cdot(-3)-2\cdot2) = \hat{i}(8+9)-\hat{j}(4-6)+\hat{k}(-3-4) = 17\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-7\hat{k}$. Area $=|\vec{A}\times\vec{B}|=\sqrt{17^2+2^2+7^2}=\sqrt{289+4+49}=\sqrt{342}\approx18.5$ square units.
